description: List the tenant's EDI trading partners: name, code, status, test mode, connection type, ISA qualifier and interchange ids, supported document types, contact, note, and counts of transactions, failed transactions and item mappings. Connection settings are never returned, only whether any are configured. Optional search over name and code. Paged: pass limit (1–100) with offset; omit limit for every partner up to 100, or PAGING_REQUIRED. While hasMore is true, call again with offset=nextOffset. Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

limit.description: Page size (1–100). Omit for every row up to 100, else PAGING_REQUIRED.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; requires limit when nonzero.

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the name or code.

name: list_edi_trading_partners
title: List EDI Trading Partners
